fix_description: In withdraw (0x2e1a7d4d), the LP share value is calculated using storage[0x0b] (virtual USD balance) which can be manipulated in the same transaction via the swap function (0xbed428bf). Attacker deposits, swaps to inflate vBalance, then withdraws at inflated value. Fix by using a time-weighted or snapshot-based balance for withdrawal calculations, or prevent deposit+swap+withdraw in the same block.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step DeFi exploit involving a flash loan, several pool deposits/withdrawals, token swaps, and interaction with a bridge whose accounting/dividend logic must be understood. While the code is not very large, the attack requires protocol-specific reasoning across multiple contracts rather than a simple obvious bug pattern.
